name: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Training and Rehabilitation in Case of Permanent Disability due to Accident
benefit: **Nature of Benefit** - Skill development training for alternative employment. - Rehabilitation support based on aptitude and interest assessment. - Training services are provided through Skill Development Mission–approved institutions.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a registered transport vehicle driver or conductor. 1. The applicant should possess a valid commercial driving or conductor license issued in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be registered on the Samagra Portal. 1. The applicant should have suffered permanent disability due to an accident.
